page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a curly brace in the right margin beside the lines "Scitis" to "Si talis" but no printed note text. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword "mores" at the lower right, signature "D 3" at the foot.

main_text.p: quisuasq; à patribus sumptas traditione reseruare licerent? Si homo Dei est, (inquit) sequatur illum. Et, unde id probabimus: interrogant. Scitis? {r}Dominum praecepisse: Tollite iugum meum super vos, & discite à me, quia mitis sum & humilis corde. Si talis ergo fit Augustinus ille, credibile est, quod Christi iugum & ipse portet, ac vobis portandum offerat. Si autem superbus aut immitis fuerit, constat quia non est à Deo, neque vobis est eius sermo curandus. Et unde id sciemus? inquiunt. Permitti-te, ait, ut ipse prior cum suis ad synodi locum veniat. Et si aduentantibus assurrexerit, scitote quia Christi seruus est, & obtemperate illi. At si vos spreuerit, aut parui æstimauerit, & nullum beni-gnitatis signum ostenderit in vultu, cum numero plures sitis, spernatur à vobis & ipse. Cum ergo venissent, & Augustinum in sella ambitiose se-dentem, nec eis amicitiæ signum aliquod præben-tem vidissent, in iram mox conuersi, eumq; super-bię notantes, cunctis quæ illis proposuit, contra-dicebant. Improperabat enim eis, quod universa-lis Ecclesiæ consuetudini contraria in multis ge-rerent, præsertim in Paschalis festi celebratione in ministerio baptismi, & in prædicationis officio, & quod hominum traditiones non curarent: man-dabatq; ut in his atque aliis, Romanæ Ecclesiæ mores

page.notes: The text is a page of the Acts with an italic-free running column. Scitis is uncertain: the printed form reads "Scitı" with a mark after it, so [?] is needed. The mark {r} before "Dominum" is a reference symbol printed in the text, not a note; its matching note is not on this page. The right-margin brace has no words. Hyphens at line ends are printed and kept. Several long-s forms were replaced by s as required. The paragraph breaks are not clearly indented, so the page is set as one paragraph continuing from the previous page.
